options.subtitle: Name an order (e.g. CD-420322) and what happened.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { output: $json.error || 'Name an order reference like CD-420322 so I can route it.' } }];

const n = $json;
return [{ json: { order_ref: n.order_ref, actor: n.kind === 'chat' ? 'operator' : n.source, kind: 'event', text: n.text.slice(0, 2000), source_ref: `run:${n.run_id}` } }];

value.text: Bahn safety: if anyone is hurt or in danger, call 112 now and get to a safe place away from traffic. Then tell us you are safe.
